# bd-smxdr follow-on — e2e scripts that exist but are invoked by nothing.
#
# Recorded 2026-09-16. Each line is an accepted, pre-existing orphan: a suite
# that was committed and wired into no runner. They are baselined rather than
# fixed here because wiring 19 never-executed suites at once would wedge the
# gate on unknown state, which is a decision for the orchestrator, not a
# side effect of adding an audit.
#
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. scripts/e2e_invocation_audit.sh fails in both
# directions: a NEW orphan is an error, and an entry here that has since been
# wired is ALSO an error telling you to delete the line. That is what stops a
# baseline decaying into a permanent ignore-list.
#
# To retire an entry: wire the script into scripts/verify.sh or a tests/*.rs
# harness, then remove its line. To retire the script itself, delete the line
# and the script — but deletion needs the operator's explicit permission
# (AGENTS.md RULE 1).
#
#
# 2026-09-16 bd-udjrq triage: 10 of the 12 non-mesh orphans were wired into
# verify.sh gate 6.12698a-j and removed from this list. The two that remain:
#   e2e_backup_roundtrip.sh    RETIRED - superseded by the registered
#                              tests/e2e_backup_restore_roundtrip.rs target.
#                              File retained per RULE 1; awaiting an operator
#                              decision on deletion.
#   e2e_field_report_suite.sh  BLOCKED - proven to emit false assert_fails
#                              through the unguarded harness PATH fallback
#                              (scripts/lib/e2e_harness.sh:69). Unblocks when
#                              that fallback refuses instead of defaulting.
#
# 2026-09-16 mesh decision: the 7 e2e_mesh_* entries were RETIRED, not wired,
# and moved to tests/fixtures/e2e_invocation/retired.txt. They contain no
# assertions -- each is an RCH dispatch wrapper around a cargo test target CI
# already runs -- so retiring them loses zero assertion coverage. That ledger
# requires a named covering command which the audit verifies actually exists in
# ci.yml or verify.sh, so "retired" cannot be used to park an inconvenient
# orphan. This list still only shrinks.
e2e_backup_roundtrip.sh
e2e_field_report_suite.sh

# 2026-09-16 bd-q2nq9: TWELVE ENTRIES ADDED. Read this before objecting that
# the list grew.
#
# These twelve were ALWAYS orphaned. They are not new debt; they are newly
# VISIBLE debt. The audit's orphan predicate scanned docs/ along with
# everything else, and a Markdown line almost never starts with '#', so an
# English sentence or a table cell naming a script satisfied it:
#     "`scripts/e2e_read_coalescing.sh` asserts this"   docs/read_coalescing.md:73
#     "| e2e | `scripts/e2e_sandbox.sh` | 21.5 |"       docs/agent-ux/.../sandbox.md:31
# A mention was standing in for an invocation -- the same mistake the predicate
# already guarded against for shell COMMENTS, in a second spelling.
#
# Each of the twelve was verified three independent ways to have NO reference in
# scripts/, tests/ or .github/: by hand on the bead, by a per-directory scan,
# and by the corrected audit itself. All three agree.
#
# "THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK" is not being weakened. The rule governs orphans
# the audit can SEE; these were invisible to it. Recording them is the
# correction, and the alternative -- leaving the gate red -- wedges verify.sh
# for every agent rather than making anyone wire a suite. From here the twelve
# are ordinary debt and the list shrinks as before.
#
# True orphan count is 21 of 92 (14 baselined + 7 retired), not 9. The earlier
# "19 of 92" figure in this file's header was measured with the same blind
# predicate and should not be treated as a clean prior.
e2e_diag_contention.sh
e2e_group_commit.sh
e2e_mesh_anti_entropy_model.sh
e2e_mesh_audit_forensics.sh
e2e_mesh_cache_retention.sh
e2e_mesh_emergency_disable.sh
e2e_mesh_remote_evidence.sh
e2e_mesh_surrogate_audit.sh
e2e_read_coalescing.sh
e2e_repo_hygiene.sh
e2e_sandbox.sh
e2e_session_budget.sh
